name: Biomass And Allometry Database (BAAD) - Pinus sylvestris Cohort
source: Biomass And Allometry Database for woody plants (BAAD)
permitted_uses: Open scientific research, non-commercial and commercial allometric evaluation with citation attribution

publication_reference.citation: Falster, D.S., et al. (2015). BAAD: a Biomass And Allometry Database for woody plants. Ecology, 96(5): 1445.
publication_reference.institution: Macquarie University & Collaborative International Ecological Coalition

constituent_publications.citation: Albrektson, A. (1984). Sapwood basal area and needle mass of Scots pine in central Sweden. Forestry, 57(1): 35-43.
Vanninen, P. & Makela, A. (2005). Carbon budget for Scots pine trees. Tree Physiology, 25(1): 17-30.
Santa Regina, I. & Tarazona, T. (1999). Annals of Forest Science, 56(8): 667-677.

geographic_scope.description: Fennoscandian and European Scots Pine Stands

collection_methodology: Destructive tree harvesting: whole-tree felling, stem dissection, and oven-drying at 105 deg C to constant dry weight.

dbh_cm.name: Diameter at Breast Height
dbh_cm.definition: Stem diameter measured at 1.30 m height above ground level.

height_m.name: Total Tree Height
height_m.definition: Vertical distance from base of trunk to apical terminal shoot.

above_ground_biomass_kg.name: Above-Ground Dry Biomass
above_ground_biomass_kg.definition: Total oven-dry mass of stem wood, bark, branches, and foliage (excluding root system).

target_variable_definition: Oven-dry vegetative mass of living above-ground components (stem, bark, branches, foliage) measured in kilograms after drying at 105 deg C to constant weight. Below-ground root systems are strictly excluded.

known_missingness_and_limitations.missingness: Crown diameter missing in 68% of cohort records; basic wood density measured at study cohort level rather than per individual tree.
known_missingness_and_limitations.geographic_limitation: Calibrated primarily on Fennoscandian boreal ecosystems; Mediterranean sample size is limited (N=7).
known_missingness_and_limitations.allometric_envelope: Sample contains young to mature commercial stems up to 41.95 cm DBH. Uncalibrated for ancient veteran trees (> 50 cm DBH).

processing_and_transformation_history.action: Raw data extraction from BAAD v1.0.1 export bundle (baad_data.zip).
Filter for Scots pine (species matched 'Pinus sylvestris') with valid DBH and dry mass.
Cross-verification of oven-dry definitions across Albrektson (1984), Vanninen (2005), and Santa Regina (1999). Flagged zero duplicate tree observations.

preprocessing_information.outlier_handling: Extreme Cook's distance filtering; biological plausibility envelope bounds checked.
preprocessing_information.missing_values: Samples missing DBH or total dry mass excluded from training split.
preprocessing_information.transformations: Logarithmic conversion and cylindrical volume proxy computation.
preprocessing_information.validation_split: 70% Train (N=200), 15% Validation (N=44), 15% Test (N=44) grouped by study cohort.
